drive.exportMeaning: export{i as t} — i(props) is the elicitation-progress status line (Flex > div[aria-live=polite] > Text) rendered in the agent chat while elicitation questions are being answered: `${answeredCount} of ${elicitationCount} answered`, or `Submitting answers…` while isSubmitting. The chunk's only export. The driver flattens the hook-free composite tree by executing the corpus Flex/Text components (see driver header).

notes: G9: first golden-backed chunk outside matrix §A — §D chat substrate, Elicitations row (issue #14 adjacency). Three prop parametrizations pin both text branches (the template `${i} of ${o} answered` incl. a zero case, and the isSubmitting branch) plus the full static sx/class/var chain: no theme stub is needed because Text resolves color through ThemeProvider's static CSS-var map (labelFaint -> var(--sx-1eapsa9)), not through useTheme.
